2026-11-01-item-5-chevron.webp | The wallpaper's three scans side by side at one height, the raw scan, scan2 turned straight and cleaned, and the small final tile, none of them meeting itself at its edges.
2026-11-01-item-5-carpet.webp | The carpet's 1K color and normal, whole and with the middle 256 texels enlarged twice, the normal's slopes slight.
2026-11-01-item-5-sets.webp | The two sets decoded from their KTX2 files, the wallpaper's albedo tiled twice each way at its repeat's shape of 17.7 by 26.4 cm, the carpet's albedo and normal tiled the same, and the strip at the wallpaper tile's left edge halfway down enlarged three times, a place whose copies lie only at the scan's edges.
2026-11-18-item-3-mirror.webp | A closed half box of 1 by 2 by 2 m mirrored across x = 0, before the mend with 11 faces and its face at x = 0 left inside on four edges three faces share, and after it with 10 faces, closed and holding 8 cubic meters, the faces drawn see-through.
2026-11-18-taper.webp | A stem of 3 m tapering from 0.3 to 0.05 m wrapped 3 round and every 0.6 m along, before its wrap followed its radius with its checker's cells squeezing round it, its width round over its length along falling from 1.011 to 0.211 a segment at a time, and after, the same stem with the ratio held at 1.047 the whole way and its cells growing finer toward the tip.
2026-11-18-windows-before.webp | A wall of 200 m with 5, 15 and 25 windows cut along its front before the mend, each front face outlined, closed at 5, open at 15 with 8 open edges, and at 25 holding 15,165 faces, 7,523 of them slivers on its front along the windows' heads.
2026-11-18-windows-after.webp | The same wall after the mend, closed with 32 and 88 faces at 5 and 15 windows, and at 25 holding 127 faces with 8 on its front, 7 open edges left where a corner far along the wall drifts by 1.5e-4 m.
2026-11-22-readme-room.webp | A room of 6 by 3 by 5 m as the module makes it, then with a window and a door cut through its front wall, then with its edges beveled by a modifier.
